_comment: Maps each demo utility to its Climate TRACE OWNER id, resolved via the toolkit's search_owners endpoint and hand-verified against 2023 owned-asset emissions. This is the IMPACT-materiality anchor: Climate TRACE measures the CO2e of the physical power assets an owner controls, i.e. the company's real-world climate impact (the outward half of double materiality), as opposed to the ESG rating, which is how the world's risks price back INTO the company. A company with no clean owner match is omitted here and renders as N.A. — never a fabricated number. Power generators are exactly what Climate TRACE tracks, so coverage is strong; a midstream gas distributor (PGAS) has no matching owner and is intentionally absent.
source: Climate TRACE v7 API (api.climatetrace.org) via climate_trace_tools

YTLP.note: The group's Singapore generation subsidiary; the YTL Power International holding company (E100000004351) carries no directly-attributed assets in Climate TRACE.
